general.title: L2P Multi-Comparison Pathway Analysis
general.instructions:
All input data uses mount name 'deg_table'. Attach your dataset with mount name 'deg_table' to replace the demo.

- (blank) or Table: auto-detects one flat table or RDS from mount 'deg_table'
- Filtered DEG: MOSuite moo-properties asset after 'filter differential expression'
- All DEG: MOSuite moo-properties asset after 'differential expression analysis'

Set Comparisons to the ordered comparison IDs in your data. Threshold selection (nominal p-value ≤ 0.05 and absolute fold change ≥ 1.2) is the default. Shared OMIX pathway bubble plots show the top 20 pathways while the CSV retains every pathway that meets the selected significance and hit-count criteria.

datasets.name: Demo DEG Table
datasets.description: Demo Mouse RNA-seq data (mount: deg_table). Replaced automatically when you attach your own dataset with the same mount name.

categories.name: Column Overrides
categories.description: Override auto-detected column names if needed

categories.name: Custom Pathways (Optional)
categories.description: Use your own pathway database instead of or in addition to built-in collections

parameters.name: DEG Table File
parameters.description:
Select the differential analysis input type. Table - uses a single flat table with differential analysis information. Filtered DEG - uses data from "Filter Differential Analysis". All DEG - uses data from "Differential Expression Analysis".

Blank / Table: auto-detect a flat DEG table (CSV/TSV/RDS) from /data/deg_table/.

Filtered DEG: MOSuite moo-properties asset at mount 'deg_table'. Loads analyses/diff_filt.csv — filtered genes, all comparisons combined. Use after 'MOSuite - filter differential expression' capsule.

All DEG: MOSuite moo-properties asset at mount 'deg_table'. Loads and merges per-comparison diff_{comparison}.csv files. Use after 'MOSuite - differential expression analysis' capsule.

parameters.name: Gene Names Column
parameters.description: Optional gene-symbol column. Leave blank to auto-detect GeneName (the demo and OMIX workflow default), then Gene Symbols and other common identifiers. Enter an exact column name to override.

parameters.name: Comparisons
parameters.description: Comma-separated comparison IDs (e.g. 'B-A,C-A,B-C'). Used to find per-comparison files in All DEG mode (diff_B-A.csv etc.) and to derive column names.

parameters.name: Species
parameters.description: Species for ortholog mapping. Non-human genes are converted to human before L2P analysis

parameters.name: Pathway Collections
parameters.description: Type one or more database codes. To run multiple databases together, join codes with commas and no spaces (e.g. H,REACTOME,KEGG). Common codes: H = Hallmark gene sets; GO = Gene Ontology; REACTOME = Reactome pathways; KEGG = KEGG pathways; WikiPathways = WikiPathways gene sets; PANTH = PANTHER pathways; PID = Pathway Interaction Database; BIOCYC = BioCyc pathways; C1 = MSigDB positional gene sets; C2 = MSigDB curated gene sets; C3 = MSigDB motif/regulatory target gene sets; C4 = MSigDB computational gene sets; C5 = MSigDB Gene Ontology gene sets; C6 = MSigDB oncogenic signatures; C7 = MSigDB immunologic signatures; C8 = MSigDB cell type signatures.

parameters.name: T-Statistic Columns
parameters.description: Optional t-statistic-column override. Leave blank to auto-detect MOSuite 'tstat' or comparison-prefixed columns such as 'B-A_tstat'. For fully custom naming, enter one column per comparison in order, comma-separated.

parameters.name: Significance Columns
parameters.description: Optional significance-column override. Leave blank to auto-detect nominal p-value columns first (for example, 'pval' or 'B-A_pval'); adjusted p-values are only used when explicitly selected or when no nominal p-value is available. For fully custom naming, enter one column per comparison in order, comma-separated.

parameters.name: Fold Change Columns
parameters.description: Optional fold-change-column override. Leave blank to auto-detect MOSuite 'FC' or comparison-prefixed columns such as 'B-A_FC'. For fully custom naming, enter one column per comparison in order, comma-separated.

parameters.name: Select By Rank
parameters.description: Use the legacy t-statistic rank method. Leave FALSE (default) to select genes by nominal p-value ≤ 0.05 and absolute fold change ≥ 1.2.

parameters.name: Select Top Percentage
parameters.description: Select top percentage of genes (vs fixed number)

parameters.name: Number of Top Genes
parameters.description: Number of top genes to select (if not using percentage)

parameters.name: Significance Threshold
parameters.description: P-value threshold for gene selection (if not using rank)

parameters.name: Fold Change Threshold
parameters.description: Fold change threshold for gene selection (if not using rank)

parameters.name: Minimum DEG Genes
parameters.description: Minimum number of DEG genes required per comparison

parameters.name: Top Pathways to Compare
parameters.description: Deprecated compatibility setting. It no longer limits the exported pathway table; use Maximum Pathways to Plot to cap only the displayed rows.

parameters.name: Minimum Significant Events
parameters.description: Minimum number of comparisons where pathway must be significant

parameters.name: Maximum Pathways to Plot
parameters.description: Maximum number of pathways to display in the bubble plot

parameters.name: Write Shared Bubble Plots
parameters.description: Write standardized OMIX pathway-bubble figures and a manifest. The deprecated capsule-local summary image is no longer written.

parameters.name: Shared Bubble Plot Top Pathways
parameters.description: Maximum pathway rows shown in each standardized bubble plot. 0 shows all eligible pathways; exports always retain all eligible pathways.

parameters.name: Bubble Plot Significance Statistic
parameters.description: Statistic used for standardized-bubble selection and significance shapes. Adjusted p-value/FDR is the default so pathway tools use the same criterion.

parameters.name: Collection Color Scale
parameters.description: Use independent color limits per collection (default) so smaller collections remain legible, or one shared scale for direct color comparison.

parameters.name: Minimum Pathway Hits
parameters.description: Minimum genes required per pathway to be considered

parameters.name: Pathway Size Limit
parameters.description: Maximum pathway size (pathways with more genes are excluded)

parameters.name: P-value Threshold
parameters.description: P-value cutoff for including pathways in results (0 = include all)

parameters.name: Use Built-in Gene Universe
parameters.description: Use built-in gene universe instead of detected genes

parameters.name: Use FDR P-values
parameters.description: Use FDR-adjusted p-values for pathway significance

parameters.name: Update Gene Symbols
parameters.description: Update gene symbols to current nomenclature

parameters.name: Custom Pathway File
parameters.description: Select custom pathway file from attached data assets (TSV/CSV format). Leave blank to use only standard collections.

parameters.name: Pathway Name Column
parameters.description: Column name containing pathway names in custom file

parameters.name: Gene Symbol Column
parameters.description: Column name containing gene symbols in custom file

parameters.name: Bubble Size Metric
parameters.description: Metric to determine bubble size

parameters.name: Bubble Color Metric
parameters.description: Metric to determine bubble color gradient

parameters.name: Bubble Max Color Value
parameters.description: Maximum value for color scale gradient

parameters.name: Pathway Label Max Length
parameters.description: Maximum character length for pathway names

parameters.name: Pathway Label Font Size
parameters.description: Font size for pathway labels

parameters.name: Dynamic Pathway Font Size
parameters.description: Automatically adjust pathway label font size based on number of pathways

parameters.name: X-Axis Title
parameters.description: Optional custom title for the x-axis. Leave blank for no title

parameters.name: Y-Axis Title
parameters.description: Optional custom title for the y-axis. Leave blank for no title

parameters.name: X-Axis Title Font Size
parameters.description: Font size for x-axis title

parameters.name: Y-Axis Title Font Size
parameters.description: Font size for y-axis title

parameters.name: X-Axis Tick Font Size
parameters.description: Font size for x-axis tick labels

parameters.name: X-Axis Tick Labels
parameters.description: Comma-separated custom labels for x-axis ticks. Must match number of comparisons. Leave blank to use defaults

parameters.name: Y-Axis Tick Labels
parameters.description: Comma-separated custom labels for y-axis ticks. Must match number of pathways. Leave blank to use defaults

parameters.name: Pathways to Remove
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of pathway names to exclude from plot

parameters.name: Rename Groups
parameters.description: Comma-separated new names for comparison groups (must match number of comparisons)

parameters.name: Vertical Line Placement
parameters.description: Comma-separated positions for vertical separator lines between groups

parameters.name: Custom Pathway Order
parameters.description: Comma-separated pathway names to define custom Y-axis order

parameters.name: Use Panel Plot
parameters.description: Use panel layout (splits comparisons into separate panels)

parameters.name: Column Spacing
parameters.description: Spacing between comparison columns in the plot

parameters.name: Plot Width
parameters.description: Plot width in inches

parameters.name: Plot Height
parameters.description: Plot height in inches

parameters.name: Output Plot Path
parameters.description: File path for output bubble plot

parameters.name: Output Results Path
parameters.description: File path for output results table
